summary: RX Tech iteration_8 — Independent verification of the new ERP Data Sync feature (sync_engine.py + /d/sync.tsx). Backend: wrote /app/backend/tests/test_erp_sync.py with 8 test classes / 15 pytest cases exercising every documented flow — import a CSV that has a TITLE row + duplicate data rows (owner) → 3 unique products inserted, party CSV → 2 parties detected, ledger CSV → 2 ledger rows detected, re-import same file → 0 inserted (dedupe on distributor_id+dedupe_key), GET /sync/data returns counts + preview (no _id leak), PATCH /sync/settings persists drive_url/auto_sync/interval_hours and clamps interval_hours>168 → 168, POST /sync/export {mode:full,format:csv} returns CSV with Invoice No/Party Name headers, {format:xlsx} returns a PK-signature xlsx zip, {mode:incremental} immediately after full → 400 'No new orders to export since your last export', GET /sync/logs contains both import+export directions, POST /sync/clear {type:all} zeroes product/party/ledger counts but leaves orders intact (subsequent full export still returns rows). Role permissions verified: manager@rxtech.com import → 200, sales@rxtech.com (field_sales) import → 403. RESULT: **15/15 backend tests PASSED (100%)**. Frontend: mobile viewport 390x844, logged in as owner via OTP flow (dev_otp banner), navigated /d/sync — 'Data Sync' title renders, Items/Parties/Ledger stat cards render, drive_url TextInput accepts + Save link shows 'Drive link saved' success toast, auto-sync-toggle switch flips, export-full-csv & export-full-xlsx trigger downloads, export-inc-csv correctly surfaces the backend 400 as an on-screen error toast 'No new orders to export since your last export.', Sync history section shows the accumulated log rows (8 import + 7 export entries visible after test run). All testIDs present and correctly wired. Deprecated packages detected: NONE in sync feature code (no expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner, expo-background-fetch). Pre-existing carry-over warnings only ('shadow*' + 'props.pointerEvents deprecated'). No blocking issues found.

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking RN Web warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated → use boxShadow; 'props.pointerEvents deprecated' → use style.pointerEvents. Already noted in iteration_6/7.

action_items: None blocking. Feature is production-ready for the mock/demo scheduling scope the user selected.

(Nice-to-have) The demo auto_sync_loop runs on a 3600s outer tick and won't fire on a 12-hour interval unless the container stays hot for many hours — fine for demo/mock scope, but if the user later wants real scheduling, move to APScheduler/Celery-beat with distributor-level cron and add a manual 'Sync now' fallback.
critical_code_review_comments: sync_engine.py:_detect uses signature-required fields per type (ledger needs party + amount|debit|credit + date|voucher; product needs name + one of mrp/rate/stock/pack/batch; party needs name + one of address/gstin/credit_limit/phone/balance/code) — this correctly disambiguates a CSV that could otherwise fuzzy-match multiple types. Verified with the test CSVs which all matched exactly one type.

Dedupe uses (distributor_id, dedupe_key) with $setOnInsert for id/created_at and $set for the rest — correct upsert semantics. Product dedupe_key = code OR norm(name)+'|'+norm(pack); party = code OR norm(name); ledger = md5(voucher|date|party|amount). Safe against title-row/duplicate-row noise.

Google-Drive fallback path (_download_drive) detects HTML confirm/interstitial pages and raises 400 'This Drive file isn't publicly accessible' — good defensive UX. Cannot end-to-end verify without a real public Drive file; code path is correct.

Role guard via staff_distributor(user, {owner, manager}) — verified live: manager 200, field_sales 403 on /sync/import. Also correctly applies to /sync/data /sync/settings /sync/logs /sync/export /sync/clear.
process_import raises 400 if total_rows==0 with a helpful message pointing at .bak-vs-export confusion — matches the client's Medica-Ultimate context.
sync_export excludes MongoDB _id in db.orders.find({..}, {_id:0}) and db.users.find({..}, {_id:0}). GET /sync/data preview also excludes _id. No ObjectId serialization risk.

MINOR (non-blocking): the auto-sync loop sleeps 3600s and only refreshes when interval elapsed since last_auto_at OR last_import_at — semantically fine, but 'demo/mock scheduling' expectation is satisfied without needing a scheduler library.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all critical /d/sync flows (drive save, auto-sync toggle, full CSV/XLSX export, incremental 'no new orders' error surfaced, sync history rendering) work end-to-end after OTP login

context_for_next_testing_agent: For OTP login in Playwright: after /auth/email → Continue, dev_otp is embedded in the URL query as ?devOtp=NNNNNN — parse it from page.url instead of scraping the banner (more reliable). To focus the first OTP box, click by bounding_box() of the second input element (index 1) — index 0 is the hidden email input carried over from the previous route. After typing 6 digits, the app may or may not auto-verify; if page.url still contains '/auth/otp', click get_by_text('Verify & Continue'). Then navigate to /d/home first to ensure token is persisted BEFORE going to /d/sync — otherwise API calls will fail with 'Missing token'. For the sync page: 'Downloaded' toast on web export is very short-lived; better to assert via the 'Last export:' meta line update or by the sync_logs row that appears in history. Incremental-after-full is a reliable indicator of full-export success (surfaces 'No new orders' toast).
